commons.title: Bailante Tradicional Zoque 05.jpg
commons.description: Religious procession that shows the syncretism in Chiapas, Mexico, despite being a procession for a Catholic saint, it shows the costumes (characterized by the plume of macaw feathers and peacock) and traditional music of the Zoque people.
commons.editorial_reason: Caption explicitly identifies a Zoque religious procession with traditional costumes and music; the image visibly shows performers in procession with drums and traditional attire.
